description: The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and the mean absolute value of the hidden state. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and employs a linear scale from 0 to 4, with tick labels at integer values. A blue dashed line represents "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," starting at approximately 0.1 at a layer value of 0, increasing to a maximum value of around 0.8 at a layer of 6, then decreasing to about 0.65 at a layer of 17, and then rapidly increasing to a value of approximately 4.1 at a layer value of 22. An orange dotted line, labeled "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," is approximately constant at around 0.04 across the entire x-axis range, from 0 to 22. A green solid line, labeled “hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04”, is nearly flat and remains near a value of 0.04 across the entire x-axis range, from 0 to 22.
